Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
a93...@zipi.fi.upm.es (CAPABLANCA) writes:
>Hello, I would like to know official ruling about maximum number of cards of
>each type in a deck (I mean a deck with 6 Blood doll or 12 flashes) I have
>read in The Duelist (some months ago) the no-limitation/6-limitation rule
>(with the 6 limitation rule aplied to Majesty,Earth Meld, Parity Shift...)
>but I have heard that the new official rules are all cards limited to 4.

>Is official this limitation?, if so , is there a new restricted card list?

No. There has never been (and, here's hoping, there never will be) a
blanket limit on cards.

BTW, the Duelist article's 6CL restricted list went out of effect on
October 1st, 1996. Now there is no limit whatsoever (except for
minimu/maximum library size and minimum crypt size) on cards - there *is*,
however, some rules changes for DCI (tournament) play - namely:

1) No repeat actions (A minion may not attempt the same type of action
more than once a turn).

2) PAs burned for votes aren't replaced until the end of the current
minion phase.

Messages.Author: Pheersum
Messages.Body:
CAPABLANCA wrote:
>
> Hello, I would like to know official ruling about maximum number of
> cards of each type in a deck (I mean a deck with 6 Blood doll or 12
> flashes) I have read in The Duelist (some months ago) the
> no-limitation/6-limitation rule (with the 6 limitation rule aplied to

> Majesty,Earth Meld, Parity Shift...)but I have heard that the new

> official rules are all cards limited to 4.

The official tournament rules have changed. There is no longer a list of
cards restricted to 6 copies. Cards are either banned:
Cunctator Motion (V:TES)
High Stakes (V:TES)
Rowan Ring (Jyhad)
Stake (Jyhad)
Monocle of Clarity (Jyhad)
Playing For Keeps (Dark Sovereigns)
or you may play with an unlimited number, however they have included a
no repeat actions rule & a no vote push rule.

1. Repeat Action rule: No single vampire can repeat an action in a turn.
This refers to the particular action type. For
example, a vampire which successfully bleeds its prey via Computer
Hacking, then untaps via Freak Drive, cannot
perform any bleeding action again whatsoever that turn, regardless of
whether or not it is a Computer Hacking action.

2. Vote Replenishment rule: Players do not replenish their hands as a
result of using political action cards as extra
votes until the end of their turn.

Many people interpret rule #2 to really mean replace your burned
political cards at the end of the current Methuselahs turn, otherwise
you start your turn with less than 7 cards if you pushed votes.

For the complete rules visit http://www.wizards.com./DCI/VTES_Rules.html
.

Messages.Author: J. Andrew Lipscomb
Messages.Body:
In article <56c5oj$3...@panoramix.fi.upm.es>, a93...@zipi.fi.upm.es wrote:

> Hello, I would like to know official ruling about maximum number of cards of
> each type in a deck (I mean a deck with 6 Blood doll or 12 flashes) I have
> read in The Duelist (some months ago) the no-limitation/6-limitation rule
> (with the 6 limitation rule aplied to Majesty,Earth Meld, Parity Shift...)
> but I have heard that the new official rules are all cards limited to 4.
>

> Is official this limitation?, if so , is there a new restricted card list?

The new official rule is that there are no limits, but the banned cards are
still banned, and two other fixes have been added (one vampire cannot take
two actions of the same kind during a single turn, and if you burn a
political action to gain a vote--as opposed to calling one--you do not
replace it until the player whose turn it is begins the transfer phase).
